name: SLAVES TO DARKNESS: VARANGUARD
description:
The Varanguard are each mighty champions in their own right, warlords who have led countless campaigns over centuries of slaughter and conquest. These god-touched knights have risen through the ranks of Archaon's legions to stand at his side, passing the many tests set for them by the Exalted Grand Marshal of Chaos. Sworn to the eternal service of the Three-Eyed King, they command the respect of mortal lords and Daemon Princes alike, for when they ride, it is at the bidding of the Everchosen alone. Where the Varanguard ride, darkness follows.

This multipart plastic kit builds three Varanguard – sinister knights sworn to the Everchosen's personal service. The Varanguard ride hulking mutated steeds, twisted mockeries of a mortal horse with tearing fangs, ripping claws, and baroque barding. The knights themselves are clad in ornate plate armour with blasphemous warpsteel shields, and can each be armed with your choice of ensorcelled weapons, daemonforged blades, and lancing fellspears.

The kit includes plenty of interchangeable components – three helmeted heads, three bare heads, three spears, three swords, two axes, a hammer, six shoulder pads, and three steed heads – ensuring you can build unique emissaries of Archaon!

This kit comprises 111 plastic components, and is supplied with three Citadel 75x42mm Oval Bases. This miniature is supplied unpainted and requires assembly – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
